arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of the Psyche at the Tree of Whispers.

Enemies near you have a {c_random}[{SF_0}*100|x%|]{/c} chance for their attacks to be interrupted.{if:SF_9} In addition, your Movement Speed is increased by {c_number}[{SF_10}*100]%{/c} and enemies are Slowed by {c_number}[{SF_11}*100]%{/c}.{/if} Does not work on bosses.
{c_important}Aura of Misfortune{/c} increases your Movement Speed by {c_number}[{SF_10}*100]%{/c} and Slows enemies by {c_number}[{SF_11}*100]%{/c}.
